_Tweaks: This file holds the interface only. Tweak names and descriptions live in Data/WinRules.ini, which is their English original. To translate a tweak, add Tweak_Name_<section> and Tweak_Detail_<section> to your own language file, where <section> is the heading in square brackets and the English wording is that heading and its Description line. Both keys are optional, whatever you leave out stays English. They do not belong in this file, because for English the app reads the ini.
